title: Nearby search on the phone
subtitle: A chip or typed text; the answer says how far around what was searched. An empty circle is about the map, never about the place. The emergency control stays in the top bar (P011f2, ADR 0018)

nodes.label: Empty field: eight chips (Banks, ATMs, Pharmacies, Hospitals, Petrol, Food, Groceries, Bus & train) and the typing hint
Chip tapped: search at once with its category and no text. Tapped again: back to the empty screen
Text typed: the chip ends; after 300 ms search with the text. The server decides if it is a kind, a brand or a name
Area, as before: the recent position, else the map centre, else none. Rounded to 2 decimals. No permission is asked
SafeRoute API: POST /v1/search. Answers with results and, for a kind or brand, searchedRadiusKm and searchedAround
Results: "Within N km of your location / the centre of the map / the place you typed", a distance on every row
Empty circle: "Nothing found within N km." and "Local shops are often missing from the map", with a link
Offline, 429 or 503: a calm message and Try again, which repeats the chip or the text
Browser opens openstreetmap.org (ACTION_VIEW, a fixed address). No browser: a line says so
Row tapped: the place goes to the map, or becomes the start of the route
